intro: Bensonhurst's Chinese population has grown quickly in recent years, with Chinese-owned business increasingly active around 86th Street. Many families are buying their first home here, and others are starting small businesses — bringing corresponding questions about closings, co-ownership, partnerships and employment. All consultation is provided in Chinese.

seo.title: Bensonhurst Chinese Legal Consultation | Home Closings, Business Disputes | Legal Dispute Help
seo.description: Chinese-language legal consultation for Bensonhurst: closing and deposit disputes, partition of co-owned property, partnership and shareholder disputes, landlord-tenant, wages and estate matters. Free initial assessment.
